title: MAPLE Project Configuration
description: Project-level configuration for the MAPLE platform (project.config.yaml).

created_at.description: RFC3339 timestamp stamped by `maple init` when the project was scaffolded.

milestone.description: Default GitHub milestone applied to new stories. Leave empty if not using milestones.

mode.description: standard: full Spec-Kit + 8-phase pipeline. spike: skips Spec-Kit; used for time-boxed research tasks.

require_adr_for.description: Change categories that mandate an ADR before proceeding.

bdd.description: BDD framework used for Gherkin scenario automation. cucumber = @cucumber/cucumber (JS/TS) or Cucumber-JVM (Java/.NET). behave = Python. none = disabled.

step_defs_dir.description: Directory for generated step definitions, relative to project root.

features_dir.description: Directory where extracted .feature files are written, relative to project root.

stack.description: Tech stack. Filled by the orchestrator during discovery; all fields null until interviewed.

frontend.description: react | vue | angular | nextjs | svelte | vanilla | none

backend.description: nodejs | fastapi | django | spring | dotnet | none

language.description: typescript | javascript | python | java | csharp | go | rust

database.description: postgresql | mysql | sqlite | mongodb | supabase | none

css.description: tailwind | mantine | shadcn | bootstrap | css-modules | none

deployment.description: vercel | aws | gcp | azure | docker | none

package_manager.description: npm | pnpm | yarn | pip | maven | gradle

ui_library.description: Component library used for mockup generation and component scaffolding.

tokens_file.description: Path to the W3C DTCG design tokens file, relative to project root.

wireframe_format.description: Default format for wireframes generated by the wireframe-architect agent.

target.description: UI medium the design phase targets. web = HTML/React/CSS artifacts and browser a11y. tui = terminal ASCII wireframes, lipgloss mockups, and terminal a11y. Selects which artifacts the design agents emit; artifact paths are identical across targets.

github.description: GitHub integration settings. Populated by `maple labels` and `maple project bootstrap`.

project_number.description: GitHub Project v2 number. null = ask once; 0 = user declined the board; N = configured board. Set by `maple project bootstrap`.

project_node_id.description: GitHub Project v2 GraphQL node ID. Set by `maple project bootstrap`.

status_field_id.description: GitHub Project v2 Status single-select field node ID, used to set a card's Status. Cached by gh-projects / `maple project bootstrap`.

milestone_granularity.description: Which SemVer classes get their own milestone. null = ask the user once; none = declined (no milestones); minor = major & minor only (vX.Y.0), patches attach to their minor; patch = also give patches their own milestone.

maple.description: MAPLE TUI state, managed by the maple binary.

sessions.description: Pinned harness session IDs, set by the MAPLE TUI (o key auto-pins, p key manual-pins).

default.description: Default DoD checklist items applied to every story. UI-bearing stories (ui: true) automatically append the design-specific items.

ui_additions.description: Extra DoD items automatically appended for stories with ui: true.
